## CPython 3.13’s Experimental Free-Threading Mode and Extensions

CPython 3.13 introduced experimental free threading as a configuration in which the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) can be disabled. In this mode, importing an extension without an explicit declaration of support triggers a warning and enables the GIL.

How an extension makes that declaration depends on whether it uses multi-phase or single-phase initialization. The declaration signals that the extension supports the free-threading runtime mode; it is separate from making the extension’s code thread-safe.
